```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(usmap)
```
```{r}
election <- readRDS(here("Output","Data","state_presid.rds"))
```

```{r}
election_df <- election %>%
mutate(
    # For Democrats: 0.5 to 1 (positive values)
    # For Republicans: -1 to -0.5 (negative values)
    color_value = if_else(dem_won == 1, 
                         dem_share,        # Democratic wins: use dem_share directly
                         -rep_share)       # Republican wins: negative of rep_share
  )

```

```{r}
plot_usmap(regions = "states", data = election_df, values = "color_value") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
   colors = c("darkred", "red", "lightpink",  # Republican gradient
               "white",                         # Center (should barely be visible)
               "lightblue", "blue", "darkblue"), # Democratic gradient
    values = scales::rescale(c(-1, -0.75, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 0.75, 1)),
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Vote Share"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(title = "US Election Results",
       subtitle = "Red = Republican win, Blue = Democratic win\nColor intensity based on vote share")
```
```{r}
load(here("Output","Data","tap.rds"))
```

```{r}
tap_graph <- tap %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert attitude to numeric for plotting
    att_t_numeric = case_when(
      att_t == "Strongly Oppose" ~ 1,
      att_t == "Oppose" ~ 2,
      att_t == "Neutral" ~ 3,
      att_t == "Support" ~ 4,
      att_t == "Strongly Support" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(rep_dem != "Ind")

# Create the faceted plot
ggplot(tap_graph, aes(x = min_maj_scale, y = att_t_numeric, color = treatment)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3, size = 1, width = 0.05, height = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE) + 
  facet_wrap(~rep_dem) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:5,
    labels = c("Strongly Oppose", "Oppose", "Neutral", "Support", "Strongly Support")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Positive" = "blue", "Negative" = "red", "Neutral" = "black"),
    name = "Framing Condition"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = 'Majority-Minority Scale',
    y = 'Attitude Towards Transgender People',
    title = "Attitudes by Political Leaning and Treatment Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
